title: Thong bao lich trinh tau Tet At Ty 2026
excerpt: Cac tuyen duong sat Bac Nam va cac tuyen phia Bac se tang chuyen trong dip Tet Nguyen dan At Ty 2026. Lich trinh cu the se duoc cong bo truoc 30 ngay.
excerptEn: North-South and northern railway routes will increase frequency during Tet 2026. Detailed schedules will be announced 30 days in advance.
content:
Tet Nguyen Dan At Ty 2026 la mua cao diem cua nam voi nhu cau di lai rat lon. Violette Train da san sang cac phuong tien va nhan su de phuc vu quy khach trong dip le nay.

Dac biet, cac tuyen HN-DN (Ha Noi - Da Nang) va HN-LC (Ha Noi - Lao Cai/Sapa) se tang them cac chuyen tau nham dam bao nhu cau di chuyen cua hanh khach.

De dat truoc ve trong dip Tet, quy khach vui long dat truoc it nhat 2-3 tuan. Cac ma khuyen mai Tet se duoc ap dung tu ngay 20 thang 01/2026.

title: Chinh sach doi tra ve nam 2026
excerpt: Cap nhat chinh sach doi tra ve tau hoa nam 2026 - ap dung cho tat ca cac tuyen duong sat Violette. Chuong trinh hoan tien linh hoat cho khach hang.
excerptEn: Updated train ticket refund and exchange policy for 2026 across all Violette Train routes. Flexible refund program for customers.
content:
Tu nam 2026, Violette Train ap dung chinh sach doi tra ve moi:

- Hoan tien 100% neu huy truoc 7 ngay khoi hanh
- Hoan tien 50% neu huy tu 3-7 ngay truoc khoi hanh
- Hoan tien 20% neu huy truoc 72h
- Khong hoan tien neu huy sau 72h

Doi ve: duoc doi 1 lan sang chuyen tau khac cung tuyen, phi doi 50.000 VND/ve.

title: Mo ban ve tuyen HN - Da Nang mua du lich
titleEn: Tickets Available: Hanoi - Da Nang Route
excerpt: Ve tau HN - Da Nang da duoc mo ban cho mua du lich he 2026 voi nhieu uu dai hap dan. Day la tuyen duong chinh cua Violette Train.
excerptEn: Hanoi - Da Nang train tickets now available for Summer 2026 travel season. This is Violette Train's flagship route.
content:
Tuyen HN - Da Nang la tuyen duong chinh cua Violette Train, voi thoi gian di chuyen 17 tieng 30 phut. Du khach se duoc trai nghiem cac toa tau hien dai, am nhac, va dich vu an uong ngay tren tau.

Dat ve ngay de nhan uu dai:
- Gia ve Standard tu 2.500.000 VND/nguoi
- Gia ve Premium tu 4.500.000 VND/nguoi

title: Ra mat dich vu tau VIP cho tuyen Sapa

title: Huong dan dat ve tau Violette Train online
titleEn: How to Book Violette Train Tickets Online
excerpt: Huong dan chi tiet cac buoc dat ve tau Violette Train truc tuyen. Nhan ve dien tu qua email trong vong 5 phut.
excerptEn: Step-by-step guide to booking Violette Train tickets online. Receive e-tickets via email within 5 minutes.
content:
Cac buoc dat ve online:

1. Truy cap violettetrain.vn
2. Chon tuyen duong va ngay khoi hanh
3. Chon tau va hang phong
4. Dien thong tin hanh khach
5. Thanh toan truc tuyen
6. Nhan ve dien tu qua email

Ho tro 24/7 qua hotline 1900 2695
